en.title: AI equities rebound as industrial profits and credit exposures reveal a more concentrated global cycle
en.deck: China's latest industrial profit figures, the Bank of England's quantified AI-financing assessment and global fund withdrawals reveal a divergence between current production and future investment financing. Tokyo and Spanish inflation and renewed oil supply risks constrain the monetary response.
keywords: Bank of England financial stability November 2026
en.regime: Selective risk recovery; concentrated industrial profit growth and differentiated credit conditions.
en.key_risk: Higher financing costs and weaker project returns could slow infrastructure orders while energy price pressures restrict policy flexibility.
watch: AI financing commitments and credit spreads

pt-BR.title: Ações de IA se recuperam, mas lucros industriais e riscos de crédito revelam um ciclo global mais concentrado
pt-BR.deck: Os novos dados de lucros industriais chineses, a avaliação quantitativa do financiamento da IA pelo Banco da Inglaterra e os resgates de fundos globais revelam uma divergência entre produção corrente e financiamento de investimentos futuros. Inflação de Tóquio e da Espanha e riscos na oferta de petróleo limitam a resposta monetária.
keywords: Banco da Inglaterra estabilidade financeira novembro 2026
pt-BR.regime: Recuperação seletiva dos ativos de risco, concentração do crescimento dos lucros industriais e condições de crédito diferenciadas.
pt-BR.key_risk: Financiamento mais caro e retornos menores podem reduzir encomendas de infraestrutura enquanto pressões de energia restringem a política monetária.
watch: Compromissos de financiamento de IA e prêmios de crédito
Inflação definitiva no Japão e na Espanha

signal_rationale.delta: Compared with 26 November tariff proposals and GDP/PCE, the new delta is NBS industrial profits, Bank of England 26 November quantified AI-credit exposure, 27 November fund flows and contrasting inflation releases. Tariffs are not the lead.
signal_rationale.evidence: NBS 27 November official data; BoE Financial Stability Report 26 November; LSEG Lipper via Reuters 27 November; Japan Statistics Bureau and INE 27 November; Reuters oil and early markets.
signal_rationale.scale_path: AI demand and contracts support financing and supplier orders; financing repricing can affect new orders before current profits fall.
signal_rationale.transmission: Expected AI returns → contract-backed debt and equity → data centre investment → equipment orders and industrial profit; energy and inflation constrain monetary offsets.
signal_rationale.falsifier: Durable improvement in paid AI demand and cash flow, narrower credit spreads, diversified industrial profitability and sustained fund inflows weaken the thesis.

key_constraints: Market data intraday; US cash session not closed.
Fund flows are sampled, not total capital flows.
BoE exposure includes contingent contractual commitments, not losses.
Tokyo and Spain inflation definitions differ.
Physical oil losses not independently verified.

producer_checks.novelty_decision: New industrial profit and financial stability evidence supports a distinct lead.
